sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Terminology 34

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Terminology 34:1
items.html: In the ten Sefirot of the Rosh [head] the Sefirot are not discernible; they are only the discernment of the “force of the ten Sefirot,” which means a root — like the seed, which is the root of the tree, and yet the tree is not discernible in it. See Part 2, answer 55. (Part 4, Chapter 1, Item 5)
